threatModel.summary: Duck exposes a public Node HTTP service backed by Discord OAuth, Discord bot privileges, local per-guild persistence, third-party AI providers, and Stripe. Attackers include unauthenticated internet clients, authenticated Discord users, restricted guild managers, malicious guild members, and reordered but valid third-party events.
trustBoundaries: internet browser to Duck HTTP server
Duck server to Discord OAuth and REST
Duck server to Stripe API and signed webhooks
validated dashboard settings to Discord bot runtime
